scenes.title: Did the goods arrive?
scenes.subtitle: Test a transaction agent before giving it purchasing tools.
scenes.source: Product purpose; no measured developer time saving
scenes.narration: A successful payment is not a delivered order. Rehearsal helps developers and quality assurance teams test transaction agents before delegation. It combines controlled failures, isolated practice, policy review, and an independent commerce ledger.

scenes.title: A real model. A separate commerce backend.
scenes.subtitle: Amazon Nova 2 Lite → Strands tools → Medusa → independent verification.
scenes.note: Actual initial frame from this recording
scenes.narration: The buyer is Amazon Nova two Lite on Bedrock, running through Strands. It must deliver three tents and six lights within five hundred synthetic credits. Medusa manages the commerce records. The browser observes those records and cannot buy anything.

scenes.title: A proposed change is not an improvement.
scenes.subtitle: A fresh reviewer has no purchasing tools; every proposal requires evidence.
scenes.note: A later malformed review rejected this attempt; preserved in the denominator.
scenes.source: Separate actual Nova B3 price-02 experiment; not this browser run
scenes.narration: In a separate actual Nova run, a tool free reviewer proposed refreshing quotes before ordering. We replayed that candidate from the same snapshot. Both executions spent four hundred and thirty credits, so the proposal did not improve the result. A later review returned an invalid field and the attempt was rejected. Initial buying, review, and candidate testing share one budget. We retain rejected attempts and their costs.

scenes.title: Actual Nova purchasing under a stock change
scenes.source: cw00-5f1698702b70-buyer · Independent transaction evidence follows the execution record
scenes.narration: This is an actual Nova run against local Medusa, shown at its original speed. The controller changes supplier A stock during the session. Model decisions pass through server checks before any order or payment. The browser shows the observed changes, delivery status, and recorded execution decisions. A sealed execution log proves file consistency. The separate export verifier establishes whether the goods arrived. After the recording ends, the final frame is held.
scenes.liveLabel: ACTUAL NOVA 2 LITE · LOCAL MEDUSA · SYNTHETIC CREDITS · ORIGINAL SPEED

scenes.title: Keep the failure in the report.
scenes.subtitle: Stock disappeared after the A order was created, before payment.
scenes.note: No replacement or successful-delivery claim inferred from a failed response.
scenes.source: cw00-ef23733b0e85-buyer · Separate actual Nova run, reaction-ui-02
scenes.narration: A different run failed. Stock disappeared after the A order was created. Payment was rejected, and Nova repeatedly retried the same payment instead of finding a valid recovery. It reached the deadline with nothing delivered. This failure remains in the evidence. The earlier successful run does not establish recovery for every timing.

scenes.title: Report every outcome and the full model cost.
scenes.subtitle: 20 planned executions per arm; failures stay in the denominator. Before delivery-prompt clarification.
scenes.note: All learning, review and evaluation model costs included; not an invoice reconciliation.
scenes.source: Separate frozen comparison · USD 2.312011 · zero unresolved reservations
scenes.narration: A separate frozen batch had 20 planned executions per method. The fixed rule baseline completed 15. The single model completed 11. The model with simulation completed 8. Simulation with Peer Review completed 7. The entire batch recorded 2.31 US dollars in model usage, including all learning and review. These samples do not establish a general Peer Review advantage. Failed, rejected and impossible cases remain in every denominator.

scenes.title: Inspect outcomes, costs and open questions.
scenes.subtitle: Source, English testing guide, architecture and retained evidence.
scenes.note: Separate post-change known pilot: B0 4/5, B1 4/5, B2 3/5, B3 4/5
scenes.source: Local English draft · Installed macOS Samantha narration · Not yet published
scenes.narration: The source includes English testing instructions, the architecture, and retained evidence. Local checks run on macOS and a same host Linux container. Independent machine reproduction, held out generalization, and observed developer time savings remain open. This proof of concept demonstrates bounded model execution and inspectable transaction outcomes. It does not claim production readiness or better policies. A later clarification of delivery waiting was tested in a separate known pilot. B0 4/5, B1 4/5, B2 3/5, B3 4/5. This is a different test set, not proof of general improvement.
